props.description: The central manufacturing resource model that represents a specific piece of equipment, machine, or production station capable of executing manufacturing processes. Workunits are the fundamental building blocks of the production floor and serve as the primary constraint resources in scheduling and execution.

props.label: Active
props.description: (Boolean!, Required, Default: true): System flag controlling whether the workunit is available for production assignments

props.label: Code
props.description: (String!, Required, Unique): Business-friendly unique identifier used for operational reference

props.label: Name
props.description: (String!, Required): Human-readable label for the workunit

props.label: Concurrency
props.description: (Int, Optional, Default: 1): Maximum number of simultaneous work orders this workunit can process

props.label: Workcenter
props.description: (ID!, Required): Parent workcenter that contains this workunit

props.label: Schedule Group
props.description: (ID!, Required, Default: "Default"): Schedule group for resource planning and optimization

props.label: Standard Duration
props.description: (Duration, Optional): Time per unit of production for standard operations

props.label: Cycle Duration
props.description: cycle time in seconds per unit of production (actual machine cycle)

props.label: Setup Duration
props.description: (Duration, Optional): Standard time required for equipment setup between different products

props.label: Process Duration
props.description: Process duration - the fixed amount of time required to perform this process, also used for OSP lead time.

props.label: Transit After
props.description: Transit time required after performing this process.

props.label: Transit Before
props.description: Transit time required before beginning this process.

props.label: Description
props.description: (String, Optional): Detailed explanation of the workunit's purpose and capabilities

props.label: Unit Per Cycle
props.description: (Int!, Optional, Default: 1): Number of units produced per machine cycle

props.label: Production Operators
props.description: (Float, Optional, Default: 0): Number of production operators required during normal operations

props.label: Setup Operators
props.description: (Float, Optional, Default: 0): Number of operators required during setup/changeover activities

props.label: Hourly Overhead Cost
props.description: (Float!, Required, Default: 0): Standard labor cost per hour for operations on this workunit

props.label: Hourly Setup Cost
props.description: (Float!, Required, Default: 0): Cost per hour during setup/changeover activities

props.label: Hourly Labor Cost
props.description: (Float!, Required, Default: 0): Standard labor cost per hour for operations on this workunit
